spans.s:
r. 10th cl. (स्नेटयति)
1 To be greasy or unctuous.
2 To fuse or melt.

mfn. (-ग्धः-ग्धा-ग्धं)
1 Smooth, oily, unctuous, greasy.
2 Amiable, kind, affectionate.
3 Coarse, thick.
4 Cooling, emollient.
m. (-ग्धः)
A friend.
f. (-ग्धा)
Marrow.
n. (-ग्धं)
1 Bees's wax.
2 Light, lustre.
3 Thickness, coarseness.
m. (-ग्धः)
1 A sort of pine, (Pinus Devadaru.)
2 Another kind, (Pinus longifolia.)
E.
ष्णिह to be unctuous, aff. क्त.

f. (-ता)
1 Affection, kindness.
2 Unctuousness, oiliness.
E.
स्निग्ध affectionate, तल् aff. of the abstract; also स्निग्धत्व n. (-त्वं.)

m. (-लः)
Rice of quick growth.
E.
स्निग्ध oily, तण्डुल grain.

n. (-रुः)
1 A pine, (Pinus longifolia.)
2 Another kind, (Pinus Devadaru.)
E.
स्निग्ध unctuous, and दारु wood.

mf. (-त्रः-त्रा)
The jujube, (Zizyphus jujuba.)
E.
स्निग्ध unctuous, and पत्र a leaf.
